segments.text: The protagonist of Ayakashi Gohan if the player decides to play the routes in the "Human Chapters".
Rin is mild-mannered and reserved. She tries not to get involved with others as much as possible. She doesn't like eating with others.
Translation of her official website character profile.
The protagonist of Ayakashi Gohan if the player decides to play the routes in the "Ayakashi Chapters".

A cheerful and energetic young lady, she can start a conversation with anybody. Rin's always hungry, and constantly thinks about what to prepare and eat next. She loves to cook, and also loves to eat with others.
Translation of her official website character profile.

Uta is a komainu, and Yomi's older twin brother. He has an aggressive personality and a sharp tongue. His delivery is sharp, but since he's trying to help, his intent isn't to be malicious. As the ayakashi's leader of sorts, he gets along with them.
Translation of his official website character profile.

Uta's younger twin brother, and also a komainu. He absolutely hates humans, and does his best to not be near them. Yomi has a very cold personality, and barely has any emotions. He tends to find almost everything a total bother. He likes to write songs, and Uta sings them. Yomi also likes to expand his knowledge, so he often reads books.
Translation of his official website character profile.

An assertive and proactive boy, he's somewhat forceful with his dealings. He loves ayakashi. Although he researches about ayakashi, he doesn't understand a lot about them. Like the "Human Chapters" Rin, he dislikes eating with others. He's the son of the chief priest of a Shinto shrine.
Translation of his official website character profile.

Suou is a nekomata. To put it positively, he's individualistic and moves at his own distinct pace. To put it negatively, he's completely out of whack in comparison to "normal" people. Suou's a misanthrope, but in reality, he's a contrarian who wants friends. He's always sunbathing on his own. Though he's extremely sensitive to the cold, he's also sensitive to the heat of hot foods and drinks, so he can't eat them.
Translation of his official website character profile.

The son of the local small store owner, Manatsu delivers ingredients to Ponpokorin. He looks forward to having a leisurely chat with Gin over tea that the latter brewed after making the deliveries. As Manatsu is young and at the ripe age for marriage, he's troubled by the neighbourhood elderly's suggestions that he attend matchmaking meetings ("omiai"). Since he's a good listener, he's often a confidant of the ayakashi.
Translation of his official website character profile.

Asagi loves pranking people; causing mischief for those who pass him by. Even so, he has no ill intentions. Since he's been living in the same area for a long time, his dream is to go somewhere far away.
Translation of his official website character profile.

The owner of the eatery, "Ponpokorin", and Rin's foster father. Gin is a youko with an "otherworldly" demeanour, and doesn't open up to anybody about his true feelings. He has a kind and gentle personality.
Translation of his official website character profile.
Tsuzuri is Gin's son. He's a half-ayakashi, half-human hybrid. Tsuzuri was shy to begin with, but since his mother's death, it got worse and now he hardly talks. He's always hiding behind Gin.
Translation of his official website character profile.

The god whom is worshipped at the Momijimura shrine. He may have the appearance of a child, but since on the inside he is a god, Kami-sama has a haughty attitude and speaks like an old man. He watches over everyone as he playfully teases them.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A Jorougumo ayakashi. She meets Rin when they pass each other in the hills located in the land at the back of school.
Translation of her official website character profile.
A firefly ayakashi. He lives quietly around a streamlet.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A cat ayakashi. As he is a nekomata like Suou, they're acquaintances.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A hitosume-kouzou youkai who's friends with Zashiki-warashi. He's naughty and mischievous. He loves to tease humans.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A zashiki-warashi youkai child who came to Susuki High during the preparations of the school festival, attracted to the liveliness. He has a calm disposition.
Translation of her official website character profile.

A tanuki ayakashi. In order to be able to properly thank Haginosuke for rescuing him, Tanukichi practices shapeshifting with his younger sister, Tanue. He has a bright disposition and cares deeply for his little sister.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A tanuki ayakashi. In order to be able to thank Haginosuke, she practicies shapeshifting alongside her older brother, Tanukichi.
Translation of her official website character profile.
A snow ayakashi. She fell in love with a human, Saku, and comes to see him only during winter.
Translation of her official website character profile.
He was classmates with Manatsu. He fell in love with Hisame.
Translation of his official website character profile.
He is a tengu. Guren is a pleasure-seeking, self-centered "ore-sama". He has a whimsical personality.
Translation of his official website character profile.
Sou is a yobuko. When Mio became all alone, he cheered her up by talking to her whilst hiding his appearance.
Translation of his official website character profile.
A lady who lives in Momijimura. She harbours one-sided feelings for Sou, though she only knows what his voice sounds like.
Translation of her official website character profile.
